answer: Before a reward seat is issued, deposits are grouped by originating withdrawal trail. The first identity from a cluster locks 1,200 units for 21 days; each later seat from that same cluster must lock 1,200 times N squared, where N is its index in the cluster. If shared control is later proven, every lock in the group is slashed. An honest agent parks 1,200 once. Fifteen clones require 1,200 × 2,480 = 2,976,000 units immobilized for three weeks, all of it at risk. Fake shops can sit as still as jade on a dune or a knoll, but the funding graph still prices them superlinearly.
